We want to onboard them as a vendor so we can get an invoice and pay quickly, but I understand Redwood defaults to PO-driven vendor onboarding.

To keep momentum, would Procurement accept an invoice-only onboarding for this short engagement? I attached: vendor intake form (filled), the SOW (draft), and a COI stub. If Procurement needs any additional docs (W-9, payment terms), we can get those same day from the vendor.

Requested next steps:
- Can Procurement confirm whether invoice-only is acceptable for a sub-$5k short-term POC?
- If yes, can you provision a temporary vendor ID and advise how we should route the first invoice?
- If no, what is the fastest path to generate a PO (timeline)?

We prefer invoice since the work starts this Thursday and a PO would slow things down. If necessary we can do both (PO after the fact) but would like confirmation so Sales can commit.

Thanks — Jordan

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the intake/SOW.

Quick answer: NimbusGrid’s standard onboarding requires a PO for new vendors. That said, Procurement can make a short-term exception for small, time-sensitive trials. Our criteria for an invoice-only exception are: (1) total spend under $5,000, (2) vendor provides W-9 and COI, (3) Procurement pre-approves and assigns a temporary vendor code, and (4) invoice payment terms are standard (Net 30).

Please have the vendor send W-9 and confirm Net 30. I can create a temporary vendor ID once those are received and loop in AP for routing. Also, all invoices must be sent to invoices@nimbusgrid.com with this PO-exception token in the subject line (I’ll provide it once the vendor is approved).

If you’d like, I can fast-track the intake once Marissa / Redwood finance confirms internal approval to accept invoice-only for this engagement.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Procurement 
NimbusGrid Inc.

Jordan / David — I spoke with Finance and Legal this morning. We can approve a temporary invoice-only intake for NimbusGrid under the following conditions:

1) Spend cap: up to $5,000 total for the first 30 days (any run-rate beyond requires a PO).
2) Required docs on file before first payment: W-9, Certificate of Insurance (attached stub OK until final), vendor bank details.
3) Risk checks: Vendor must pass our standard sanctions screen and have no outstanding disputes.
4) Tracking: Finance will create a temporary vendor code (VG-2026-089) and tag invoices as "TEMP-INVOICE-LANE" in the AP system.

Assuming NimbusGrid sends W-9 + final bank details, we will instruct AP to accept the first invoice and pay Net 30. Please confirm back to Elena and procurement so they can assign their token for subject-line routing. I uploaded a short PROC ticket and added the intake with the assigned vendor code.

Jordan — please confirm once you’ve collected the W-9 and banking info and I’ll mark the intake cleared.
